# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 11 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB BTO — November 2026 Exercise

- **November 2026 BTO draws roughly four applications per flat by midday on Day 7** - HDB's November 2026 exercise had received 31,776 applications for 7,964 flats by midday on 10 November, with one day still remaining to apply. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/november-2026-bto-application-rates/)

- **Seven projects launched across six towns in the final BTO exercise of 2026** - HDB launched 7,964 flats in Bedok, Geylang, Sembawang, Tengah, Toa Payoh and Yishun on 4 November — the first exercise under higher income ceilings for families. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/november-2026-bto-launch-highlights/)

- **February 2027 BTO preview: around 4,300 flats across Bishan, Tampines, Tengah and Toa Payoh** - HDB will also run a Sale of Balance Flats exercise alongside the February launch, bringing combined supply to roughly 9,300 homes. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/february-2027-bto-launch-preview/)

## HDB Resale Market

- **Million-dollar HDB resale flats hit a third consecutive monthly record in October 2026** - A record 238 HDB resale flats transacted at S$1 million or above in October, up from 209 in September and 201 in August, representing 10.9% of October's total resale volume. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/million-dollar-hdb-resale-record-october-2026/)

- **Yishun executive flat sets new $1.329M record despite being smaller than the previous record holder** - A 1,765 sq ft executive flat at Block 652 Yishun Ave 4 sold for $1.329M ($753 psf), even though it is 183 sq ft smaller than the flat that previously held the record. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/yishun-executive-flat-crossed-1-3m/)

## Commercial & Luxury Residential

- **Foreign groups in deals worth up to $11 billion for Singapore's landmark commercial buildings** - Hongkong Land and IOI are acquiring well-known Singapore commercial assets in transactions that could total approximately $11 billion. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-marquee-assets-having-moment-year/)

- **Two adjoining Good Class Bungalows near the Botanic Gardens offered at $53M combined** - The freehold properties at 15 and 15A Camden Park in District 11 are available via Expression of Interest at $26M and $27M respectively, either separately or as a pair. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/two-side-side-bungalow-plots-near/)
